params.prompt: Wide cinematic photograph for a website hero background, 27:16. The upper 45% of the frame is an empty, softly textured wall washed in saturated orange-red light, darkening toward the corners (deep #7A1E06 at the edges, glowing #F2621C near the centre), left clear for a large headline. The lower-centre 55% shows, seen directly from behind, a young video editor with dark curly hair wearing black over-ear headphones and a dark hoodie, seated in an office chair at a wide desk with three monitors: the left monitor shows a colourful video edit timeline and a clip bin, the centre monitor shows a film frame of a person at a window at dusk, the right monitor shows colour-grading scopes and three colour wheels plus an audio spectrum. Two studio monitor speakers stand on either side of the desk, a small mixing controller with glowing knobs sits on the desk, a coffee mug at the right. Everything is lit in warm orange-red practical light with deep shadows; the desk and chair edges fade softly into the orange darkness at the bottom and sides. Photorealistic, 35mm, subtle film grain. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no brand names, the person's face is not visible.
